article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms webcast announcement (captured 2011-10-07, post date not shown; it says 'posted 2 days, 2 hours ago'). It promotes the Spooktacular event and a SOE Webcast on Thursday, October 6, 2011 covering Spooktacular, Farming updates, and the new mini-game 'Spot the Difference'. The article itself contains no mechanics details.

article_summaries.title: Farming Comes to Free Realms
article_summaries.summary: Ten Ton Hammer relays SOE's April 2011 announcement that Free Realms added farming on PC and Mac. Every player gets a Wilds Farm instance; crops are grown, harvested and converted to coin via mini-games, and farms level from 1 to 20 with Membership required beyond level 5. The press release gives the feature list and the player count used in the boilerplate.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms Webcast Recap
article_summaries.summary: A recap of the SOE webcast held Thursday, October 6, 2011, with Referee Ruby, Producer Harvey Burgess, Game Designer Christopher Fritchoff and Senior Artist Matt Case. It covered the Spooktacular event, Farming updates, the new mini-game "Spot the Difference", and a discussion of vampires and werewolves. The article gives no mechanics or numbers.
